title: JERA courts Anthropic and Meta for data centres wired straight into its power plants
summary: JERA, Japan's largest power producer, is in talks with Anthropic, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft and Google about placing data centres beside its thermal plants around Tokyo, chairman Yukio Kani told Nikkei. The behind-the-meter model draws power directly from the plant, skipping grid connection queues that can run for years. The template is an October memorandum with Dell and RHAELM for a site at the Chiba plant, planned at up to 400MW and more than $15 billion, with operations from 2028. None of the five companies had commented when Reuters reported the talks.
